title: verify_peer data
description: Emitted when a new peer needs verification (Strict or Quick mode). Client must respond with verify_response within 2 minutes. A peer that connects to the server is rejected without this event while another connection with its key is pending, or, if it is unknown, while 8 unknown peers that connected are pending. Known peers do not count toward the 8, and a peer the user dials (dial or a reconnect) is never rejected this way. stop_server and restart_server reject the pending prompts of peers that connected to the server; verify_response then fails with verification_not_found.

numeric.description: Numeric fingerprint of the peer's key: 40 digits in eight groups of five. This is the code to compare with the peer over a trusted channel before accepting; the emoji fingerprint is too short to rely on alone.

emoji.description: Array of emoji strings for fingerprint display.

known.description: Whether this peer is already in the known-peers list.
